name: TurnTimer
intent: Mono-text duration counter for an agent turn — live while working, frozen and de-emphasised when complete.
when: Show how long an agent turn has been running

extracted: cva variants/sizes remain generated by the structural extractor

lineage.confidence: unset — projection round-trip verified; no held-out eval yet

props.name: startedAt
props.description: When the turn started. Used to compute elapsed time. If omitted, the component uses its mount time. Re-render with the same value to preserve the count.

props.name: done
props.description: When true, the timer freezes at its current value and renders the dim "done" state.

props.name: value
props.description: Override the displayed value (e.g. show a precomputed final duration).

props.name: tickIntervalMs
props.description: Tick interval in ms while live. Defaults to 100.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.
